title: GRAPHICS HOOKS
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program: add all of it. This is the frame the rest hangs on. The drawing code gets named hooks where the new work goes: after the camera, on the ground, under the bodies (shadows), in the air (smoke, fire, explosions), a switch around the lighting (off keeps the light exactly as it is now), before the fog of war (bloom, so nothing glows through fog), after it (the colour grade) and before the HUD (grain). The game side gets quiet hooks where a shot is fired, a round hits a wall, a charge or a Howler shell bursts and a machine dies (which now remembers what kind it was), each skipped in a bot raid and drawing nothing from the raid dice. Every picture a graphics build bakes is listed in one place and thrown away if the graphics card resets. A bypass switch turns all of it off for comparing. Nothing on screen changes yet.
now: The drawing code now has hooks for the graphics program; nothing looks different yet.
